events.title: Eurozone Manufacturing Sector Logs Robust Growth
events.description: The euro area manufacturing activity expanded at a solid pace in October despite slowdown in factory order growth and intensifying supply-chain pressures, final purchasing managers' survey data from S&P Global showed Monday. The final manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index fell to 52.7 in October from 52.9 in the previous month, which was the highest score since May 2022.

events.title: Indian Shares Rise For Third Day, Reliance And Tata Steel Lead Rally
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Monday, extending gains for a third consecutive session as heavyweight Reliance posted stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings and oil prices slumped amid diplomatic efforts to end the war in Iran.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Inflation Concerns Ease
events.description: Gold prices traded higher on Monday as inflation concerns eased ahead of U.S. midterm elections.

events.title: Oil Prices Slump As Iran-Qatar Talks Continue
events.description: Oil prices tumbled on Monday as investors weighed reports of continued talks between Iranian and Qatari officials aimed at ending the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran against fears of renewed U.S. military action against Iran.

events.title: European Shares Struggle For Direction In Lackluster Trade
events.description: European stocks struggled for direction on Monday after Fitch warned that France's debt outlook is worsening, expressing doubts about the country's ability to sustainably restore its public finances after the 2027 presidential election.

events.title: Yen Falls After Japan Katayama's Intervention Warning
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Monday, after Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama remarks due to uncertainty over when the BoJ is expected to raise rates next.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As Oil Prices Ease
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Monday amid growing concerns about massive AI spending. Asia's factory growth continued to expand in October, but growth slowed in major chip exporters, private surveys showed earlier today.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Monday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Higher As Lower Oil Prices Ease Inflation Fears
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Monday as inflation concerns eased ahead of U.S. midterm elections.

events.title: Indian Shares Rally As Crude Oil Eases
events.description: Indian shares opened on a buoyant note on Monday, with easing oil prices and renewed buying from foreign institutional investors amid concerns over the outlook for AI trade elsewhere globally helping underpin investor sentiment.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market trading on Monday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,850.00 level, with weakness in gold mining and financial stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are trading mixed on Monday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday, amid weakness in technology stock which mirrored their peers on tech-heavy Nasdaq on renewed concerns about the AI trade. Markets also keep an eye on the ongoing discussions between Qatari mediators and Iranian officials to end hostilities in the Middle East which could ease supply concerns.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher As AI Selloff Deepens, Oil Prices Ease
events.description:
Indian shares look set to open higher on Monday, with information technology stocks in the spotlight after the tech-heavy Nasdaq plunged to its lowest closing level in three months on Friday amid renewed concerns about the artificial intelligence trade.
 
Additionally, ongoing discussions involving Iranian officials and Qatari mediators have raised hopes of possible breakthrough that could ease supply concerns and improve the outlook for global energy markets.
